_comment_openrouter: OpenRouter unified endpoint. model_name is the OpenRouter model slug. Opus 5 has extended thinking on by default, which consumes part of max_tokens before any visible output — kept high (16384) and temperature at 1.0 (Anthropic requires temperature=1 when thinking is enabled; a fixed lower value can be rejected).
_comment_vllm: Self-hosted via vLLM. base_url (localhost) only works from inside the job that launched the server. model_name must match the HF checkpoint passed to `vllm serve`.

vllm/qwen3.5-4b._comment: Sampling params follow Qwen's recommended non-thinking settings; a low temperature with no repetition_penalty caused infinite repetition loops.

_comment_llamacpp: CPU-hosted via llama-cpp-python with a quantized GGUF checkpoint instead of the original bf16 weights (a deliberate speed-over-comparability tradeoff). base_url (localhost) only works from inside the job that launched the server.

llamacpp/qwen3.5-4b-gguf._comment: Qwen3.5-4B-Q4_K_M.gguf (int4) from huggingface.co/unsloth/Qwen3.5-4B-GGUF. Sampling params copied from vllm/qwen3.5-4b. model_name is the llama.cpp server's served-model label, not an HF checkpoint id.

llamacpp/qwen3.8-27b-gguf._comment: Qwen3.8-27B-UD-Q4_K_M.gguf (Unsloth Dynamic 4-bit, ~16GB) from huggingface.co/unsloth/Qwen3.8-27B-GGUF, as a CPU alternative to the OpenRouter-hosted model. Decode throughput is only a few tokens/s, so use for small workloads.

_comment_vllm_metal: Self-hosted locally via vllm-metal (MLX backend, Apple Silicon) with a 4-bit MLX quantization of Qwen3.8-27B (mlx-community/Qwen3.8-27B-4bit) rather than the FP8/bf16 weights -- a deliberate precision tradeoff.

vllm/qwen3.8-27b._comment_time_cap: Overrides the default per-task time cap for this slow self-hosted model: 2h for vanilla, 6h for aide/mlevolve (many sequential LLM calls per task).
vllm/qwen3.8-27b._comment: Official Qwen FP8 checkpoint (Qwen/Qwen3.8-27B-FP8) on 2 GPUs with max_model_len 65536 and enforce_eager true. A single GPU loads the weights but leaves too little KV-cache capacity for these prompts.
